Summary: Default administrator credentials are prefilled in the login form
Expected: Login inputs are empty and no credential is exposed by the client
Actual: Administrator email and password are prefilled in browser-visible inputs
Notes: Default frontend credentials removed. Static validator passed, frontend typecheck and build passed, and founder browser re-audit confirmed that both fields are empty.

Summary: Dashboard does not identify today's required actions or exceptions
Expected: Dashboard prioritizes work, alerts, exceptions, approvals and quick actions
Actual: Dashboard primarily displays static totals and platform status
Notes: Founder browser re-audit confirmed the operational command-centre redesign. The dashboard now surfaces priorities and exceptions, provides six quick actions, presents compact portfolio health, and separates financial position from platform readiness. The pilot blocker is removed.

Summary: Sidebar is excessively long and mixes resident and administration navigation
Expected: Navigation is grouped into clear collapsible operational domains
Actual: Long continuously scrolling list mixes portals, operations and administration
Notes: Founder browser re-audit confirmed eight collapsible administrator navigation groups, resident/admin separation, automatic active-group expansion, removal of the duplicate Dashboard label, and materially reduced sidebar scrolling.

Summary: Landing page does not communicate the platform's key differentiators
Expected: Landing page explains supported verticals, extensibility and open-source value
Actual: Landing page provides only a short description and two administration actions

Summary: Sticky administration header overlays the property form while scrolling
Expected: All form labels and controls remain fully visible below the sticky application header at every scroll position
Actual: Property Type and Description content become hidden behind the sticky header
Reproduction: Open /properties/new and scroll through the form
Notes: Long property-form routes now use a non-sticky administration header, preventing form content from passing beneath the top bar. Browser re-audit remains required.

Summary: Create Property is a long ungrouped form without a clear secondary action
Expected: Fields are organized into understandable sections with required-field guidance and Create and Cancel actions
Actual: All fields appear in one long card and only the primary Create Property action is visible
Reproduction: Open /properties/new and review the complete form
Notes: Property form reorganized into Basic Information, Address and Configuration sections. Required and optional guidance, Cancel action, persistent action area, structured loading and accessible error feedback added. Browser re-audit remains required.
